metadata.case_name: YEUNG HAU KEUNG v. YIP WANG KIT T/A HANG PARK DECORATION CO AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: cement work, plastering, carpentry and demolition of internal decoration

injuries.description: 23% total body surface area mixed superficial and deep dermal burns to his anterior and posterior trunk, as well as bilateral arms and forearms.
injuries.body_part: anterior and posterior trunk; bilateral arms and forearms
source: Further examination revealed that he suffered from 23% total body surface area mixed superficial and deep dermal burns to his anterior and posterior trunk, as well as bilateral arms and forearms.

injuries.description: Hypertrophic scars secondary to the burn injuries; permanent scars and cosmetic deformity.
injuries.body_part: chest wall and left upper limb (scars mentioned); widespread over trunk and arms
source: The wounds gradually healed but the plaintiff developed hypertrophic scars secondary to the burn injuries.
There would be permanent scars and cosmetic deformity, though they should improve with time (months and years);

treatments_received: admission to Accident & Emergency Department and transfer to Burn Unit Ward of Department of Surgery at Queen Mary Hospital
occupational therapy (work hardening program and assessments)

losses.description: Permanent scars and cosmetic deformity secondary to burn injuries causing cosmetic disability and need for pressure garments / steroid therapy.
Permanent scars and cosmetic deformity may affect work capacity; plaintiff may be disadvantaged in the labour market and have difficulty in finding and retaining employment.
